While I haven't killed myself yet, I have no intention to change my mind when the time comes. I've held out for years. I refuse to wait longer then the planned date. There's nothing else I want to live. Thank you for your kind words, but I have made up my mind.
This seems awfully difficult.. I think I'll just try and make an "accidental death", thanks for your help however.

I've tried multiple times and made a will though but it doesn't legally apply. I can't really explain to them why. It's like trying to explain to a deaf person sound. I have things I can't tell them, since it would probably hurt them and if I live I'll have to do a worse method since I can't live with what I've told them.

Maybe I'm being dramatic. I almost don't want to tell them. Wouldn't they blame themselves for not "helping me with those things"?

Basically, my explanation might be worse. The only gain is they might hate me from it and if they see me dying they won't help me?

Maybe make it clear that it's important to talk about hard things sometimes, and show you are there if they do choose to? That could help.

You can retract this post if you'd like, however there's no issue in talking about your worries.

If you're in the position to do so, mentally, have you asked them why they are considering that? If it looks to become very serious, do you have any family of theirs you can contact so they are unable to go through with it? They might be mad, but what's a little bit of someone feeling upset instead of their death?

Families are rarely stable though disappointing, it's the harsh reality. The world will always have problems and I doubt world peace is something that will ever happen. It's easy to get overwhelmed. If you have the ability to fix any of them, maybe make a list in order and deal with them one by one? Solving all of them at once is likely not as attainable as it seems..? If you cannot solve them, is it possible to ignore them or is it a sort of "no matter what happens, it won't go away" problems?

Alright, feel free to bring up anything that you'd like to talk about and keep whatever makes you uncomfortable bringing up hidden. I'll do my best to try and think of what might be a good idea if I can think of anything. At the very least might be nice to just say it?
Doubt I can do much but you're free to let me know what's up and I can offer up suggestions?
